tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Slack OAuth credentials and API connectivity.

tools.name: list-channels
tools.description: List public and private channels in the Slack workspace. Supports pagination.

types.description: Comma-separated channel types: public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im. Default: public_channel,private_channel

tools.name: get-channel
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Slack channel by ID.

tools.name: create-channel
tools.description: Create a new public or private Slack channel.

name.description: Channel name (lowercase, no spaces, max 80 chars). Will be normalized.

isPrivate.description: Create as private channel. Default: false

tools.name: archive-channel
tools.description: Archive (close) a Slack channel. Archived channels are read-only.

tools.name: join-channel
tools.description: Join a Slack public channel by ID or name.

tools.name: invite-to-channel
tools.description: Invite one or more users to a Slack channel.

userIds.description: Array of Slack user IDs to invite (e.g. ['U1234567890'])

tools.name: send-message
tools.description: Send a message to a Slack channel, DM, or user. Supports blocks and attachments.

channel.description: Channel ID (C...), user ID (U... for DM), or channel name (#general). For DMs use the user's ID.

text.description: Message text. Required fallback if blocks not provided.

blocks.description: Optional JSON string of Slack Block Kit blocks for rich formatting.

threadTs.description: Optional thread timestamp to reply in a thread. Format: 1234567890.123456

asUser.description: Post as the authenticated user. Default: true

tools.name: send-thread-reply
tools.description: Reply to a specific message thread in Slack.

channel.description: Channel ID where the parent message is located

blocks.description: Optional JSON string of Slack Block Kit blocks

broadcast.description: Also broadcast reply to the channel. Default: false

tools.name: list-messages
tools.description: List messages from a Slack channel or thread. Supports pagination and time range.

channel.description: Channel ID to fetch messages from

threadTs.description: If provided, fetch replies in this thread instead of channel history

oldest.description: Start of time range (Unix timestamp string). Default: 24h ago

latest.description: End of time range (Unix timestamp string). Default: now

inclusive.description: Include messages at the boundary timestamps. Default: false

tools.name: add-reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message.

channel.description: Channel ID where the message is located

tools.name: remove-reaction
tools.description: Remove an emoji reaction from a Slack message.

channel.description: Channel ID where the message is located

tools.name: list-users
tools.description: List users in the Slack workspace. Supports pagination and optional presence.

includePresence.description: Include user presence status. Default: false

tools.name: get-user
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Slack user by ID or email.

userId.description: Slack user ID (e.g. U1234567890). Mutually exclusive with email.

email.description: User email to look up. Mutually exclusive with userId.

tools.name: get-user-presence
tools.description: Get the online/presence status of a Slack user.

tools.name: upload-file
tools.description: Upload a file to Slack and optionally share it to a channel or DM.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload

channels.description: Comma-separated channel IDs to share the file to (e.g. 'C123,C456')

initialComment.description: Optional initial comment to post with the file

threadTs.description: Optional thread timestamp to upload the file to a thread

tools.name: list-files
tools.description: List files uploaded to the Slack workspace. Supports filtering by channel, user, and time range.

tsFrom.description: Filter files created after this timestamp (Unix format)

tsTo.description: Filter files created before this timestamp (Unix format)

types.description: Filter by file type: all, spaces, snippets, images, gdocs, zips, pdfs. Default: all

tools.name: search-messages
tools.description: Search messages across the Slack workspace.

query.description: Search query. Supports Slack search syntax: in:#channel, from:@user, before/after dates, etc.

sort.description: Sort by relevance (score) or time (timestamp). Default: score

tools.name: search-files
tools.description: Search files across the Slack workspace.

query.description: Search query. Supports Slack search syntax: in:#channel, from:@user, type:pdf, etc.

sort.description: Sort by relevance (score) or time (timestamp). Default: score

tools.name: get-team-info
tools.description: Get information about the connected Slack workspace (team).
